# ffxf_vm_backups (Data Source)

Lists backups and automatic-backup settings for a virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_vm_backups" "example" {
  vm_id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `automatic_enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic backups are enabled.
- `backups` (Attributes List) Available backups. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))
- `retention` (Number) Number of retained automatic backups.

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Backup creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Opaque backup identifier.
- `restorable` (Boolean) Whether this backup can be restored.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Backup size in bytes, when known.
- `type` (String) Backup type, automatic or manual.
